headline: DJ Akademiks Celebrates Doodie's Not Guilty Verdict in Smurk Case
body: DJ Akademiks posted on Instagram today announcing Doodie's acquittal in the Smurk case. The post, which garnered 6,809 likes and 532 comments, states: 'Doodie lo celebrating not guilty for Smurk.' The artist's social media presence has been active following the legal outcome, with fans reacting to the verdict. This development comes as the music community watches closely for further implications.
